tehran-online-2022.notes: Source 1 is the site of the 2022 Tehran regional; its front page gives the regional as 27-28 April 2023 while the schedule page and the regional scoreboard time stamp say 18-19 May 2023. The online contest's poster PDF (iipc.pdf) in our copy is truncated at 1048576 bytes.

sources.evidence: The front page lists the 19th Iran Internet Programming Contest, 16 March 2023, and the site holds its internet-contest page, its scoreboard 'ICPC 2022 Internet Programming Contest' (Thu Mar 16 2023) and its Persian problem PDF.
